doc_friction.issue: Says venture-preflight takes over 5 min; fine, but nothing says whether a firmware/host-only change inside a venture (no page or site files touched) needs it, so it was run anyway.

notes: Built a second straddle vote at the take survey's 2.5 ms candidate: board counts (ResidualSurvey.straddle2_for/against, from the 2.5 ms fit's own edge flag, no extra fit), two more TAKE_SURVEY frame bytes (older frames decode with None), Pi advice with host.TAKE_STRADDLE2_MARGIN (larger lead wins when both votes fire, 1.5 ms on a tie), and tests/take_straddle_vote.py --margins2. Design on 15 stored sets (636 builds): margin 2 named 333->355 of 540, 0 of 96 instant misadvised; margin 1 misadvised 5. Pre-registered in d6222e636, then 30 fresh captures (270 builds, 90 instant): 102->110 of 180 named, 0 of 90 instant misadvised, 0 lost, board counts equal to rebuild on all 270 frames. Shipped TAKE_STRADDLE2_MARGIN = 2. Verification: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests (see PR), venture-preflight.
